blocks.text: The transition to New Outlook for Mac

Microsoft has made the New Outlook for Mac the standard experience. You should use it to ensure you receive the latest security and feature updates. Legacy Outlook support is ending in October 2026. This means you must prepare your workflow for the current interface. You can switch between views via the Outlook menu in the menu bar. If you see sync errors like code -3253, check your internet connection first. These errors often occur when the server connection drops during heavy synchronization tasks.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for legal secretaries

Speed is vital when you handle hundreds of emails. Use ⌘ + 1 to jump to Mail. Use ⌘ + 2 to open your Calendar. Use ⌘ + 3 to view your Contacts. Press ⌘ + N to start a new email. Press ⌘ + S to save a draft. Press ⌘ + Return to send your message. You can create custom shortcuts for other actions. Go to System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts. Add Outlook and type the exact menu command name. This saves time when performing repetitive tasks like flagging messages or moving items to specific folders.
Managing high email volume and attachments

Legal email often involves many attachments and long threads. Use folders to keep your inbox clean. Right-click a folder to create sub-folders for specific cases. Use rules to move incoming emails from specific clients to these folders automatically. Go to Settings > Rules to set these up. You can filter by sender or subject line. This prevents your main inbox from becoming a bottleneck for your work. Always check for large attachments before sending. If a file is too big, use a secure document management system link instead.

Missing a court deadline is not an option. Use the Calendar view to track every appointment. Create a new event with ⌘ + N while in the Calendar tab. Add the location and set reminders for one day before the event. You can share your calendar with attorneys to keep everyone aligned. Use the Share button in the top right of the calendar view. Choose the permissions level carefully. Only share what is necessary for the team to see.
How to stay productive with Lazur

Lazur helps you manage your Mac without constant clicking. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask where a setting is. Lazur will circle the button on your screen. Hold fn to dictate emails. This is faster than typing for long correspondence. Lazur keeps your dictation clean and formatted. Use it to draft quick responses to clients. You can also ask Lazur to summarize long email threads. This helps you grasp the context of a case quickly. It does not store your content or train models on your data.

faq.question: Can I use legacy Outlook for Mac in 2026?
faq.answer: Support for legacy Outlook with Exchange Online ends in October 2026. You should switch to the New Outlook for Mac now.

faq.question: How do I create a custom shortcut in Outlook?
faq.answer: Go to System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts. Add Outlook and enter the exact menu name.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons and guides you, but it does not click or operate the app for you.
